_description: Grilling #26 follow-up — curated cross-level pathways bypassing |Δlevel|≤1 (R5) and brainstem eligibility (R9) constraints. Each entry is an anatomically documented connection blocked by the tripartite model's structural rules but verified in the neuroanatomical literature.

pathway_classes.perforant_path: Entorhinal↔Hippocampal formation — the classic tri-synaptic circuit input/output. EC layer II→DG/CA3, EC layer III→CA1, subiculum→EC return.
pathway_classes.amygdalofugal: Amygdala input/output pathways — ventral stream sensory→amygdala (LeDoux high road), amygdala→sensory feedback, amygdala→brainstem/hypothalamic output (stria terminalis, ventral amygdalofugal).
pathway_classes.thalamocortical_relay: Thalamus→primary sensory cortices — LGN→V1, VPL/VPM→S1, MGN→A1. Not cortico-cortical; first-order thalamocortical relay.
pathway_classes.cerebellothalamic: Cerebellum→cortex via thalamus (dentate→VL→M1, interpositus→VL→M1). Cortico-ponto-cerebellar loop return path.
pathway_classes.prefrontal_limbic: PFC↔amygdala/hippocampus/NAcc — emotion regulation, fear extinction, cognitive reappraisal, reward integration. Top-down control pathways.
pathway_classes.dmn_core: Default Mode Network core hubs — PCC/RSC↔precuneus/entorhinal. Adjacent DMN nodes with strong resting-state functional connectivity.
pathway_classes.ventral_stream_emotion: Ventral visual stream→amygdala/parahippocampal — face/object/scene perception feeding into emotional and memory systems.
pathway_classes.brainstem_subcortical: Brainstem↔subcortical shortcuts — amygdala→PAG/LC, VTA→amygdala, raphe→hippocampus, SC→amygdala. Blocked by R9 brainstem eligibility (not just |Δlevel|).
